tokenName: Investment Bank Agri Warehouse Receipt Token
description: Investment Bank aggregates warehouse receipts from rural cooperatives and smallholder storage facilities across Ethiopia and structures them into investable digital tokens. Farmer groups receive immediate liquidity against stored produce while investors gain commodity-backed income. Reduces post-harvest losses and creates stable farmgate employment.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Informal Services Contract Token
description: Investment Bank structures pools of verified gig and informal economy contracts in Ethiopia into investable instruments. Plumbers, electricians, caterers, security guards and cleaning service providers receive DID-verified digital contracts, enabling them to access advance payment against future earnings. Reduces the financial vulnerability of informal workers.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Community Infrastructure PPP Token
description: Investment Bank structures public-private partnership infrastructure projects with mandatory local employment clauses in Ethiopia. Token holders finance road, bridge, school and hospital construction projects that must employ a minimum 70% of local citizens. Revenue-sharing distributions paid on project completion milestones.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia PPP Act; Employment-Linked Infrastructure Token Policy

tokenName: Investment Bank Social Housing REIT Token
underlyingAsset: Social and affordable housing investment — Ethiopia
description: Investment Bank structures tokenised social housing portfolios in Ethiopia, enabling anyone to invest in government and private affordable housing programmes. Returns from rental income and property appreciation are distributed to all token holders. Creates housing supply, rental income for ordinary investors, and construction jobs simultaneously.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Structured daily labor proof instruments — Ethiopia
description: Investment Bank pools and structures ProofOfWork tokens from verified informal sector workers in Ethiopia into impact investment products. A portfolio of 10,000 daily labor tokens from market traders, casual construction workers and domestic workers gives investors exposure to the informal economy while providing workers with verifiable work history and access to credit.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Youth Employment Milestone Token
description: Investment Bank structures project milestone tokens for youth employment and skills development programmes in Ethiopia. Each token is minted when a young person completes a certified training milestone or employment module. Token proceeds fund the next cohort of apprentices. Investors gain impact credentials while youth gain marketable skills and income.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Agricultural Value Chain Token
description: Investment Bank structures seasonal agricultural loans into investable tokens for farms of all sizes in Ethiopia. Institutional investors fund pre-season inputs; smallholder farmers repay at harvest. Structured in tranches from micro (subsistence farmers) to commercial (export farms) so every income level of investor can participate. Reduces hunger and agricultural unemployment.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Community SME Growth Token
underlyingAsset: Structured community SME investment pool — Ethiopia
description: Investment Bank structures pools of micro and small enterprise lending into rated investment tokens for Ethiopia. Market vendors, home bakeries, tailors, mobile phone repairers and informal traders gain working capital. Retail and institutional investors earn blended returns. Portfolio diversification across 500+ SMEs reduces risk while maximising community impact.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Inclusive Economy ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Blended formal and informal economy ETF — Ethiopia
description: Investment Bank manages an ETF that tracks a basket of all tokenised asset classes in Ethiopia — from government bonds and listed equities to farmer warehouse receipts, SME tokens and labor proof-of-work instruments. One token gives an investor exposure to the full breadth of Ethiopia's economy — from boardrooms to market squares.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Retail Equity Access Token
description: Investment Bank packages fractional equity in listed Ethiopia companies into retail-accessible digital tokens starting from one currency unit. An office cleaner, a night-shift nurse, or a rural market trader can now own a piece of Ethiopia's top companies. Promotes broad-based capital accumulation and reduces wealth inequality.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Community Development Bond Token
description: Investment Bank structures community development bonds in Ethiopia with proceeds earmarked for rural electrification, clean water, and digital connectivity — all generating local employment. Token holders receive coupon payments from government guarantees. Accessible from minimum one currency unit to include salary earners and market vendors as bond investors.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Public Finance Act; Community Development Bond Tokenisation Rules

tokenName: Investment Bank Diaspora Remittance Impact Token
description: Investment Bank channels diaspora remittances into productive investment in Ethiopia through impact tokens. Instead of remittances being consumed, they are tokenised into community enterprises, housing, agriculture and SME investments. Family members abroad become investors in their home communities, creating jobs, building assets and generating returns.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Community Mining Revenue Token
description: Investment Bank structures revenue from artisanal and small-scale mineral extraction in Ethiopia into regulated investment tokens. Mining communities receive fair prices via transparent on-chain auctions. Token investors gain direct exposure to copper, cobalt, gold and other critical minerals without intermediary exploitation. Environmental compliance is token-gated.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Farmer credit history via verified output — Ethiopia
description: Investment Bank structures pools of verified AgriPoW records from thousands of Ethiopia smallholders into rated impact investment products. The more a farmer's verified output history grows, the higher their token earning rate. Investors fund the next season's inputs; farmers repay through tokenised harvest receipts. Creates a self-reinforcing agricultural prosperity cycle.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Bank Agri-Commerce Supply Chain Token
description: Investment Bank structures supply chain finance instruments across the agricultural and commerce value chains of Ethiopia. Transporters, processors, packers and market distributors all participate as token-earning nodes. Supply chain finance injections at each node reduce spoilage, lower prices for consumers and create stable employment for thousands of workers.
regulatoryFramework: Ethiopia Financial Markets Act; Ethiopia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024
